title: Topicals – We Roll Up
metaDescription: Relatively new on the market, cannabis-infused topicals are safe, efficient and wonderfully versatile.

blocks.html: Relatively new on the market, cannabis-infused topicals are safe, efficient and wonderfully versatile. Balms and lotions are applied directly to the skin and the cannabinoids are absorbed for localized treatment of soreness, inflammation, pain, and numerous skin issues. Because they are non-intoxicating, topicals can be applied multiple times per day with no worries over feeling high.

blocks.html: There are natural cannabinoid CB1 and CB2 receptors in the skin that interact with the active compounds in cannabis. Along with the curative potential of terpenes and cannabinoids, such as THC and CBD, topicals from We Roll Up include essential soothing oils like lavender, eucalyptus and peppermint. Hydrate the skin with Mango Seed Oil, Shea Butter and Jojoba Oil and appreciate head-to-toe benefits. Our topicals are ideal for targeted relief.
